name: llama.cpp Qwen3-VL-4B vision (Vulkan)
description: Dedicated vision model for image understanding: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct Q8_0 with its F16 vision projector, served by llama.cpp (Vulkan) on Strix Halo gfx1151. OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with image input on 127.0.0.1:8012. Registers as the crow-vision provider for vision profiles (Meta Glasses look turns, photo captions) and the vision role. Always on, outside the chat model's VRAM group, about 7-8 GiB of unified memory. Licences: Qwen3-VL weights Apache-2.0, llama.cpp MIT, container image kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes (third party). Weights are downloaded separately (see the compose file).

providers.description: Vision-language endpoint (Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct Q8_0 + mmproj, llama.cpp Vulkan)
